body: Founder real-time direction from earlier this session: 'we will port the four gods to GFD after validation.' Milestones 2-4 (Four Heavenly Kings, §3.4 anti-stall escalation, King respawn) plus §25.3 synergy decay -- all fully validated in REDGARDEN earlier today (Apples #12827/#12831/#12839/#12844) -- are now ported into GoblinFoxDragon's apps2/battlegrounds_gui fork. Used a real 3-way merge (git merge-file, base = this fork's own Milestone-1 commit bff785f, mine = this fork's current arena_game.h/.c, theirs = REDGARDEN's current files) instead of a blind overwrite, since the fork had its own independent Milestone-1-era comment wording worth preserving. arena_game.c merged byte-identical to REDGARDEN's current file, zero conflicts. arena_game.h had one trivial conflict (empty mine-side vs pure addition, resolved by taking theirs) and one merge-tool blind spot the tool didn't flag as a conflict at all: a stale duplicate ArenaCampMinion struct definition survived alongside its Milestone-2+ camp_index-extended replacement, because the base definition had MOVED (not been edited in place) going from base to REDGARDEN's HEAD -- a real diff3 limitation, caught by a hard compile error, not by eyeballing the diff, and fixed by deleting the stale copy. Verified: gcc -fsyntax-only against this fork's own src/main.c (SDL2 GUI client compiles clean, unaffected), plus a standalone smoke test mirroring this fork's own established no-build-script/direct-gcc-verification precedent from the Milestone-1 pass -- synergy-tier safe default at init, all 4 Kings silent before 1:00 and spawned by 1:00, a real North-King kill-to-death loop with Wealth-buff pickup confirmed, King respawn confirmed on its own 2:30 timer. All 6 Jungle Camps milestones are now done in both REDGARDEN and this fork. Not yet exercised by an actual running client session in this fork (no automated test harness exists here the way REDGARDEN has test_arena.sh/test_10_bots.sh) -- flagged, not faked. GoblinFoxDragon commit 434c629.
title: Jungle Camps Milestone 5: Four Heavenly Kings ported to GFD's battlegrounds_gui fork, validated via real compile + smoke test
